subject: JuraRegel repository and documented development process
scopeLimitations: No IVO Rechtspraak, Azure, OpenShift, SaaS or production tenant was inspected.
Repository evidence cannot prove operating effectiveness in a cloud environment.
No independent ISO 27017 reviewer has approved the local interpretations.

findings.risk: No scoped cloud responsibility matrix or technical allocation test exists.
findings.measure: Create and independently validate a service-specific responsibility matrix.
findings.residualRisk: Cloud security activities can remain unassigned or conflict with effective permissions.

findings.risk: No cloud partner agreement, SLA, audit right or exit evidence is in repository scope.
findings.measure: Review each material cloud agreement against the approved responsibility matrix.
findings.residualRisk: Contractual gaps can prevent assurance, incident cooperation or exit.

findings.risk: Repository tests do not test tenant or workload isolation in a target platform.
findings.measure: Define trust boundaries and execute negative isolation tests in an approved environment.
findings.residualRisk: Cross-tenant, cross-workload or lifecycle-environment access is untested.

findings.risk: No authorized cloud/SaaS inventory or discovery coverage statement is available.
findings.measure: Define inventory ownership and compare it with approved read-only discovery sources.
findings.residualRisk: Shadow cloud, AI, MCP and API use can remain invisible.
